text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any involuntary muscle movements like tremors or dystonia, and have you recently started or increased the dose of your haloperidol? REQUEST TEST: Creatine_Kinase

text: The significantly elevated creatine kinase level, combined with your fever, generalized rigidity, altered mentation, and history of haloperidol use, strongly points to Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome
